description: This file implements Google Chat webhook handling, message processing, reply delivery, and monitor setup for a chat integration module.

methods.name: registerGoogleChatWebhookTarget
methods.description: Registers a webhook target for Google Chat and returns an unregister function.

methods.name: normalizeAudienceType
methods.description: Normalizes the audience type string to predefined types.

methods.name: handleGoogleChatWebhookRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming webhook requests from Google Chat.

methods.name: processGoogleChatEvent
methods.description: Processes a Google Chat event, filtering message events and invoking message pipeline.

methods.name: resolveBotDisplayName
methods.description: Resolves the display name of the bot with fallback options.

methods.name: processMessageWithPipeline
methods.description: Processes a chat message through access policies, envelope building, and reply pipeline.

methods.name: downloadAttachment
methods.description: Downloads and saves an attachment from Google Chat media.

methods.name: deliverGoogleChatReply
methods.description: Delivers a reply message to Google Chat, handling media, typing indicators, and chunking.

methods.name: uploadAttachmentForReply
methods.description: Uploads media attachment for reply to Google Chat.

methods.name: monitorGoogleChatProvider
methods.description: Sets up webhook registration and monitor for Google Chat provider.

methods.name: startGoogleChatMonitor
methods.description: Starts the Google Chat monitor with provided options.

methods.name: resolveGoogleChatWebhookPath
methods.description: Resolves the webhook path for a given Google Chat account.

methods.name: computeGoogleChatMediaMaxMb
methods.description: Computes the maximum media size in MB for Google Chat based on account config.
